solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Warning to Scots on holiday to return

indicators.note: to return is to come back, so the letters are read backwards

parts.note: in Scots dialect the word 'to' is pronounced and written tae
vac is short for vacation, a holiday; on vac means away on holiday

explanation.surface: A cautionary word to Scottish holidaymakers about going home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return' reverses TAEVAC. CAVEAT is Latin for 'let him beware'.
explanation.definitionFit: A caveat is a formal caution or proviso, a synonym for a warning.

clue.text: "Summon and I grant access!" as the poet said to his muse

parts.note: to call is to summon

parts.words: grant access!" as the poet said
parts.note: ope is a poetic, archaic form of open

explanation.surface: A poet calling on his muse, inviting her to let him in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as the poet said' marks OPE as poetic language.
explanation.definitionFit: Calliope is the Greek Muse of epic poetry, so a poet's inspiring goddess.

clue.text: Barbarian's game interrupts call to hospital

indicators.note: interrupts means breaking into, so the game goes inside the call word

parts.note: to call on someone is to visit
go is the Japanese board game

explanation.surface: A savage's sport breaks up a trip to hospital.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'Barbarian's' stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Visigoths were a Germanic people who sacked Rome, the archetypal barbarians.

clue.text: It encourages the gourmet to copy it in the mountains

parts.note: to ape is to copy or imitate

indicators.note: in places the it within the mountain name

parts.note: the Rif is a mountain range in northern Morocco

explanation.surface: Something tempting the food lover to mimic it high in the hills.
explanation.walkthrough: The Rif is a range in northern Morocco; 'in' sets the second 'it' inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An aperitif is a drink taken before a meal to stimulate the appetite.

clue.text: Note as source of cider drunk during performance

indicators.note: during places the scrambled letters within the performance word

parts.note: an act is a performance on stage

indicators.note: drunk suggests something reeling and jumbled, so the letters of cider are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone credits cider for a tipsy turn on stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drunk' turns the letters of cider into CREDI, and 'during' puts them inside the performance word. 'Note as source of' reads as accrediting something to someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To accredit something to someone is to attribute it, noting them as its origin.

clue.text: Pass on tale of dog

parts.note: a col is a mountain pass
a tale is a falsehood, a lie

explanation.surface: Gossip relayed about a dog.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pass on' reads as relaying; Pass is a mountain col.
explanation.definitionFit: A collie is a breed of sheepdog.

clue.text: Somewhat less than dependable character (female)

parts.note: a rat is a disloyal, treacherous person
her is the female pronoun

explanation.surface: A slightly untrustworthy woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Rather means to some extent, a little, as in rather cold.

clue.text: First-class student owned up to bloomer

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the letters are read from the bottom

parts.note: A1 is first-class, with the 1 read as I
L is a learner driver, a student
had means owned

explanation.surface: A top student admitted to a blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' suggests a mistake but is a flowering plant. 'up' reverses AILHAD.
explanation.definitionFit: A dahlia is a flowering garden plant, and a bloomer is a crossword name for a flower.

clue.text: Seaman to attain objective

parts.note: a tar is a sailor
to get is to obtain or attain

explanation.surface: A sailor's aim to reach his goal.
explanation.definitionFit: A target is an aim or goal, something one sets out to achieve.

clue.text: No, X is. Pay attention!

indicators.note: No contradicts a statement, so the clue words are a reply to the answer read as a claim

parts.note: X is the Roman numeral for ten, the correct version of the claim being contradicted

explanation.surface: An exasperated teacher correcting a pupil's Roman numerals and demanding attention.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as the claim 'L is ten': the reply 'No, X is' corrects it, since L is the Roman fifty.
explanation.definitionFit: To listen is to pay attention; the imperative matches the command form.

clue.text: Missile manufacturer left out by singer

indicators.note: out here means put out of order, so the letters of left are rearranged

parts.note: Cher is the American pop singer

explanation.surface: A weapons maker abandoned by a vocalist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Missile manufacturer' sounds like arms industry; a fletcher makes arrows. 'out' rearranges the letters of left into FLET.
explanation.definitionFit: A fletcher is an arrow maker, and arrows are missiles.

clue.text: German woman gets old district back to front

indicators.note: the rear part of the word is carried round to the front

parts.note: a riding was one of the old administrative divisions of Yorkshire

explanation.surface: A German lady acquires an old district reversed in some way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back to front' moves the ING of RIDING to the start. The Ridings were the three historic divisions of the English county of Yorkshire.
explanation.definitionFit: Ingrid is a woman's given name common in Germany and Scandinavia, an example of a female name.

clue.text: Old currency adopting new view? This may shock

indicators.note: adopting means taking in, so the currency word holds the other letters

parts.note: the lire were Italy's currency before the euro

indicators.note: new signals the letters of view made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: Italy's former money takes on a novel outlook, with a shocking warning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges the letters of view into VEWI, which 'adopting' places inside the old Italian currency.
explanation.definitionFit: A live wire carries current and gives an electric shock; figuratively, a lively person.

clue.text: Left part of Europe for part of Africa

parts.note: Iberia is the peninsula of Spain and Portugal

explanation.surface: Someone who quit Europe for Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Left' looks like departed; it is just L.
explanation.definitionFit: Liberia is a West African country, an instance of a region of that continent.

clue.text: Told to enter text with ornament

indicators.note: told means spoken, so the answer is how the phrase sounds when said

parts.note: to type in is to enter text at a keyboard

explanation.surface: Instructions to key in text accompanied by a decoration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Told' signals that TYPE IN said out loud gives TIE PIN.
explanation.definitionFit: A tie pin is a decorative pin worn on a necktie, a piece of men's jewellery.

clue.text: Set free, having gone off

parts.note: to put is to set something down
rid means freed, as in rid of a nuisance

explanation.surface: Something released after it has spoiled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having gone off' sounds like setting out, but it means spoiled food.
explanation.definitionFit: Putrid food is rotten, which is what food that has spoiled is.

clue.text: Not such a smart calculation for starters

parts.note: dim means unintelligent, not bright
a sum is an arithmetic calculation

explanation.surface: A foolish piece of arithmetic for beginners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for starters' looks like a beginners' sense; it is a menu of starters.
explanation.definitionFit: Dim sum are small Chinese dumplings and snacks, served as appetisers or light dishes.

clue.text: See 15
Arsonist's rage beginning to blaze in stuffy atmosphere

indicators.note: in places the anger and the first letter of blaze inside the stuffy atmosphere word

parts.note: a fug is a warm, stale, stuffy atmosphere
ire is anger or rage

indicators.note: the beginning of the word blaze is its first letter

explanation.surface: A fire-raiser's fury starts a blaze in a stuffy room.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'Arsonist's' stands for 'is', joining definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Firebug is informal slang for someone who sets fires deliberately.

clue.text: Copious issue involving former S. African currency in quest for easy money

indicators.note: involving means enclosing, so the outflow word wraps the rest

parts.note: a gush is a copious outflow
old means former
R is the rand, South Africa's currency

explanation.surface: A flood of old rands in pursuit of fast cash.
explanation.definitionFit: A gold rush is a mass stampede to a goldfield in hope of quick riches.

clue.text: Cheeky devil's impression on university

parts.note: an imp is a little devil
a dent is an impression made in a surface

explanation.surface: A rascal's mark left on a university.
explanation.definitionFit: Impudent means insolently disrespectful, a synonym of cheeky.

clue.text: Capitalist alternative to sporting underwear

parts.note: sporting a garment is wearing it, being in it
a vest is an undershirt in British usage
or introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: A financier's choice instead of wearing underclothes.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a vest is an undergarment worn under a shirt.
explanation.definitionFit: A capitalist puts money into enterprises, which is what an investor does.

clue.text: A believer in sailors boarding satellite

indicators.note: boarding means getting on, so the sailors go inside

parts.note: the moon is Earth's natural satellite
RM is the Royal Marines, sea soldiers who stand in for sailors in crosswords

explanation.surface: A faithful person among seamen climbing onto a moon.
explanation.definitionFit: A Mormon is a member of the Latter-day Saints church, so a religious adherent.

clue.text: Pin twister

definitions.meaning: a long pin for holding meat
one who skews or distorts things

explanation.definitionFit: A skewer is a spit or pin; also, read differently, a person who skews or slants.

clue.text: Unproductive soldiers in farm building

indicators.note: in places the soldiers inside the barn

parts.note: a barn is a farm building
RE is the Royal Engineers, British army soldiers

explanation.surface: Idle troops stationed in a farm shed.
explanation.definitionFit: Barren land or stock yields nothing, so it is fruitless or sterile.

clue.text: Drop litter on distant dispute

parts.note: far means distant
a row is a quarrel or dispute

explanation.surface: Dropping rubbish during a far-off quarrel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drop litter' looks like fly-tipping; it means a sow giving birth.
explanation.definitionFit: To farrow is for a sow to give birth to a litter of piglets.

clue.text: See 13
One model embracing another's publicity material

indicators.note: embracing means hugging, so the poser word goes round the other

parts.note: a poser is someone who poses, a model
the Model T was Ford's famous car, so another model is T

explanation.surface: One fashion model hugging another for an advertisement.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'another's' stands for 'is'. Ford's Model T supplies the T.
explanation.definitionFit: A poster is a printed placard used for advertising.

clue.text: Two kings supplying alias to a largely defunct island

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king and R is rex, Latin for king
aka is short for also known as, an alias

explanation.surface: A pair of monarchs lending a false name to a vanished isle.
explanation.walkthrough: The two kings are K and R (rex).
explanation.definitionFit: Krakatoa, an Indonesian volcanic island, was mostly destroyed by its 1883 eruption.

clue.text: Put forward modern Italian leader

parts.note: AD, anno Domini, marks the modern era
Il Duce was Mussolini's title as Italian leader

explanation.surface: Proposing a contemporary Italian head.
explanation.definitionFit: To adduce is to cite or offer evidence or an argument for consideration.

clue.text: J's, say, and classical boat, and how to propel one backwards

indicators.note: backwards means the combined letters are read in reverse

parts.note: et is Latin, the classical language, for and
Noah's ark is a boat
you row a boat to propel it

explanation.surface: A list of a letter, an ancient vessel and how to drive one in reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'J's' is J/s, joules per second, a rate of doing work. 'backwards' reverses ETARKROW.
explanation.definitionFit: Joules per second measure power, which is literally the rate at which work is done.

clue.text: Gleaming coin found after left turn

parts.note: a U-turn, so U stands for a turn
a cent is a small coin

explanation.surface: A shiny coin discovered after turning left.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' puts the coin word last.
explanation.definitionFit: Lucent means shining or luminous, a literary synonym for gleaming.

clue.text: Disease going badly wrong within boundary

indicators.note: within places the scrambled letters inside the boundary word

parts.note: a rim is an edge or boundary

indicators.note: badly signals the letters of wrong are put in poor order

explanation.surface: An illness worsening inside a perimeter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' rearranges the letters of wrong into NGWOR, which 'within' sets inside the boundary word.
explanation.definitionFit: Ringworm is a contagious fungal skin infection that forms ring-shaped patches.

clue.text: Their women become increasingly virginal

indicators.note: become signals the letters change into a new form

explanation.surface: Their wives grow more and more chaste.
explanation.walkthrough: 'become' works on 'Their', turning it into the last five letters, with W for women in front.
explanation.definitionFit: White symbolises purity, so whiter is more pure, more innocent and chaste.
